authority.battle_clock_rng_hp_status_events: game_battle_checkpoints.payload only; active_battle is a pointer
authority.local_backup: signed server checkpoint copy, never authorizes currency writes
authority.UI_draft: local configuration only; no optimistic wallet

game_command_receipts.retention: keep immutable ID/hash/result permanently; no large full-save copies in receipts

game_save_history.retention: last20 revisions plus last7 daily tips; receipts retain original outcomes

commit_order: authenticate JWT and bind UID outside payload
lookup receipt and compare canonical request hash
pure decideCommand with server time and injected seed
SQL lock owner row; receipt lookup again; revision CAS
same_id_same_hash: return original receipt even if old revision/content, before current-content admission; client fetches latest state if needed
new_id_stale_revision: 409 REVISION_CONFLICT, no command mutation; reload then new intentional command ID
rejected_business_command: store rejected receipt, no account revision/currency change

farm.reserved_cursor: advance atomically on fixed pending claim reservation, exactly once
farm.paid_flag: only when resources+items are atomically applied; pending already reserved intervals are never regenerated
farm.rate_switch: reserve old interval under old snapshot then switch; old pending remains payable
farm.patch: old stored numeric rate/drop snapshot until next reservation; use aliases/compensation migration for old definitions
farm.too_old: discard excess older than12h and move reserved_through to now once claim reserved
farm.full_queue: deny new reservation/start before mutation; allow salvage/fusion/claim operations to free space

battle_protocol.checkpoint: full virtual state after timestamp barrier; server recomputes requested interval, browser only predicts
battle_protocol.offline: no credited combat after last authorized checkpoint; gap>=lease aborts, never catch-up a boss during AFK
battle_protocol.daily_abort: attempt stays spent; last committed phase/HP/chests retained
battle_protocol.story_tower_abort: no reward/unlock; free new attempt full team HP/SP
battle_protocol.speed: battle.advance may carry speed 1/2/4 (player fast-forward, D-071): credited game time = min(requested, wall gap × speed, max_credited_wall_gap_ms × speed); lease/ticket wall limits unchanged, AFK/offline rewards stay wall-time based

compatibility.result: abort old active battle; settle farm from old snapshot; recompile next build, never apply patch midcast
incompatible replay, retain old bundle for audit; abort active battle with mode policy
ordered atomic migration with ledger/ID maps and receipt; no implicit best-effort
engine hash/replay unchanged, presentation hash may change

interruption.durable: highest clear and fixed pending first-clear reward
spent attempt and last committed phase/HP/chests in ticket day
interruption.transient: party HP/SP/events cleared; boss progress retained

migration.price_change_refund: exact actual paid vector; free grants zero; mark ledger refunded once in same commit as reset
migration.old_skill_removed: require explicit alias+cap remap or one-time paid refund and detach skill; unknown required IDs block release
migration.old_item_removed: require compatible alias/retained legacy definition or explicit compensation migration; no silent delete
migration.rollback: roll code only if compatible with migrated schema; otherwise maintenance; never roll wallet backward over receipts
migration.backup_restore: same account, known signed history tip or verified replay to latest tip; stale local blob never overwrites newer cloud; recovery operation requires quarantined/corrupt save

rls.authenticated: SELECT own account_id=auth.uid(); no direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/RPC writes
rls.service_role: server only; API binds authenticated UID and commit RPC not exposed to authenticated/anon

ledger_compaction.active: one coalesced entry per character+feature+skill; actual paid vectors sum, cost_versions tracks all versions; cost_version denotes latest contribution
ledger_compaction.refund: remove active entry and archive refunded full entry with refund command ID in immutable receipt; repeated new reset finds no refundable entry
ledger_compaction.nonrefundable_features: level/refine/card upgrade receipts retained, no refundable ledger entry required because release never refunds them
ledger_compaction.bounded_size: current skills+enchant lines at most136 active scopes over seven characters; refunded history stays in receipts, not account JSON

hash_policy: Runtime bundle hash = SHA256(engine data projection + game schema hash + implementation source hash); presentation-only assets have separate hash. Requests must match exact runtime content_hash; human version strings alone are insufficient.
